# freeCodeCamp

> freeCodeCamp's design system and branding reference for maintaining visual consistency across the platform.

This resource documents freeCodeCamp's design standards, typography choices, color palette, and branding guidelines. It serves as the authoritative reference for designers, developers, and contributors working with freeCodeCamp's visual identity.

## Key Topics

- style-guide
- design-system
- typography
- color-palette
- logo-guidelines
- branding
- visual-identity
- Lato
- SaxMono
- Google Fonts

## Design System & Branding

- [freeCodeCamp Style Guide](https://design-style-guide.freecodecamp.org/): Design system and branding guidelines for freeCodeCamp including typography, colors, logos, and visual identity standards.
